screenReader.detail: No screen reader (NVDA / JAWS / VoiceOver / Orca) is installed or drivable in this environment. No manual screen-reader pass was performed and none is claimed. The ARIA live-region behaviour below was verified programmatically (role/aria-live attributes and their rendered text), which is NOT the same as verifying what a screen reader actually announces.

states.label: Resolution centre (listing, blocking items outstanding)
states.anchorAssertion: the listing renders at least one item question

states.label: Owner choice (radio group of household members)
states.anchorAssertion: a radio option exists for the "self" household member

states.label: Blocking-unresolved state (dismissal refused, statement still blocked)
states.anchorAssertion: the screen states this item cannot be hidden because it blocks the statement

states.label: Joint allocation editor (percentage split across owners)
states.anchorAssertion: the "Who owns which share?" editor with per-owner percentage inputs

states.label: Duplicate decision (same event / separate events / wrong statement)
states.anchorAssertion: the three closed-vocabulary duplicate answers are offered as radios

states.label: Correction overlay (what has been decided so far, with masking disclosure)
states.anchorAssertion: the "What has been decided on this so far" decision history section

states.label: Resolved state (history view showing a terminal item, badge "Resolved")
states.anchorAssertion: at least one item carries the "Resolved" status badge

keyboard.label: Radio groups — arrow keys move focus AND selection within the group
Focus order — Tab traverses interactive elements in DOM order and reaches the primary action
keyboard.detail: 37 tab stops; DOM-order monotonic=true; reached "Save this answer"=true

keyboard.label: Labels — every form control has a programmatic accessible name
Loading announcements — the load transition is inside a polite live region
Error announcements — a real API failure is surfaced in a role="alert"
Save announcements — the post-save confirmation is inside a role="status" region
keyboard.detail: role="status" announced: "Answer recorded and the statement re-checked — nothing else is outstanding on it."
